task_text: What MSG SEVIRI product variants are available on the EUMETSAT server and what satpy reader should be used to open them?
ground_truth_scope: MSG SEVIRI variants exposed by this repository server, not all EUMETSAT holdings.

MSG-SEVIRI-L1-HRY.reader_acceptance: Accept advertised reader for catalogue answer; accept native reader when explicitly qualified for native .nat archives. Do not treat readers as interchangeable for every format.

MSG-SEVIRI-L1-IODC.reader_acceptance: Accept advertised reader for catalogue answer; accept native reader when explicitly qualified for native .nat archives. Do not treat readers as interchangeable for every format.

MSG-SEVIRI-RSS.reader_acceptance: Accept advertised reader for catalogue answer; accept native reader when explicitly qualified for native .nat archives. Do not treat readers as interchangeable for every format.

provenance.extraction_method: Executed the exact tool function against AST-extracted static products_list constants without importing downloader clients or starting the MCP server. No live EUMETSAT API/download called.
provenance.refresh_policy: Refresh when installed eumetsearch catalogue or server reader handling changes.

evaluation_policy.normalization: Resolve product names, keys and collection-ID aliases to canonical keys. Normalize formatting; reader identifiers must identify the correct reader.
evaluation_policy.pairing: Check each product-reader pair, not independent sets of products and readers. Missing products count in set recall; report mapping coverage separately rather than hiding omissions.
evaluation_policy.format_exception: seviri_l1b_native is valid for native .nat files, as the server fallback indicates; seviri_l1b_hrit is the advertised reader and is appropriate for HRIT data. Accept explanations distinguishing the two.
evaluation_policy.not_required: No download, format inspection, numeric statistics or product-availability precondition is requested.
evaluation_policy.execution_status: GT retrieved; candidate scoring/validator not run.
